name: How long does permitting usually take for a remodel in Los Angeles County?

mainEntity.name: How long does permitting usually take for a remodel in Los Angeles County?
mainEntity.text: How long does permitting usually take for a remodel in Los Angeles County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permit timing depends on how complicated the project is and how complete the plans are when submitted. Simple interior work may move relatively quickly, while projects involving structural changes, additions, or multiple disciplines can take much longer. Corrections from plan check are one of the biggest reasons approvals slow down, especially when drawings are incomplete or engineering details are missing. The approval clock also depends on how fast the design team responds to comments and how many review cycles are needed. Homeowners should not assume permits will be instant, and they should not schedule demolition based on an optimistic date. In practice, permit duration should be built into the project schedule from the start. A contractor familiar with Los Angeles processes should be able to give a realistic range and explain which items are likely to trigger review. The safest approach is to treat permitting as a distinct phase rather than a minor administrative step.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permitting time can range from a few weeks for simple work to several months for larger or more complex remodels. The timeline depends on scope, plan completeness, corrections, and how quickly responses are submitted.
